newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian Totra Tekstil to list its shares on OTC.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian Totra Tekstil to list its shares on OTC.

text.p: Slovenian textile products maker Totra Tekstil will list its shares on the over-the-counter (OTC) section of the Ljubljana bourse on June 13, the stock exchange said on Friday.
The company will list 225,515 ordinary shares, with a nominal value of 1,000 tolars each ($6.35), representing 72.17 percent of its total equity.
Totra joins a batch of 28 companies that have been listed on the main or OTC sections of the Ljubljana bourse since January of last year.
Currently there are 28 issues traded on the main market and 40 on the OTC market. -- Novica Mihajlovic, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
